No duplicate generated-folder-name column or inline preview.

Approx 286 x 68 px, corner radius 12 px, at the existing bottom-right action location. Absolutely NO metallic sheen, specular spots, silver rim, glowing edge, glass, large shadow, plastic bulge or gradients on this primary button. Subtle short ambient shadow at most. 5. Change the ENTIRE base window background to an EVEN LIGHT GRAY approximately #E2E3DF, neutral with a very slight warm cast. It must visibly read as light gray, not white. Keep exact top labels: 导入媒体; 来源; EOS_DIGITAL (E:); E:\DCIM; 导入到; F:\影像库; 选择文件夹 in both path controls. RAW, JPEG, 视频 and 重新扫描. Bottom status 待导入, an empty pale gray horizontal track in the same bottom area, no percentage or metrics. Text and icons charcoal #292B28, secondary text #686B65. Fine row separators in a slightly darker gray than the base. No added sections, title for the list, tasks/history, media thumbnails, redundant totals, progress cards, explanations, format-extension list, decorative imagery or annotations. The result should be a calm, usable desktop utility with gray and warm-white harmony, clearly real text inputs and subtle source/target glass.
